executive_summary: PAT-LES-5fdc0399f479: lib/eva/decision-filter-engine.js's low_score trigger is a two-tier check (min_score for a HIGH-severity floor, chairman_review_score for a MEDIUM-severity ceiling, per the Vision v4.7 redesign), but the chairman_review_score preference key was undocumented across all three places the EVA decision-filter preferences are documented -- a downstream consumer reading the docs would not know the key exists or that low_score has two tiers at all. LEAD-TO-PLAN's own mechanism-claim-verifier gate caught that the pattern's stated default (9) does not match the source (3.0); this PRD's scope is documentation-only, using the verified value. No code behavior changes.

functional_requirements.description: Rewrite Trigger 4's Configuration and Evaluation Logic sections in docs/guides/workflow/cli-venture-lifecycle/reference/filter-triggers.md to show both filter.min_score (default 2.0, HIGH floor) and filter.chairman_review_score (default 3.0, MEDIUM ceiling, verified at lib/eva/decision-filter-engine.js:75), the real three-way branch, and the stage 3/5 STAGE_SCORE_THRESHOLDS overrides. Correct the pre-existing wrong key name (filter.min_score_threshold -> filter.min_score). Add a caveat flagging that the adjacent Score Interpretation / Chairman Override Capability subsections still assume an unverified 0-10 scale, left unfixed as a separate, deeper finding.
acceptance_criteria: filter-triggers.md's Trigger 4 Configuration table lists both preference keys with their verified defaults
The Evaluation Logic block shows the HIGH/MEDIUM/no-trigger three-way branch, not a single IF/THEN
filter.min_score_threshold no longer appears anywhere in the file

technical_requirements.title: No code changes -- documentation only

risks.risk: The SD's own stated defect premise (default 9) is factually wrong, which could mislead a PLAN/EXEC pass that trusted the SD text verbatim instead of the source file
risks.mitigation: Verified independently via an Explore sub-agent against lib/eva/decision-filter-engine.js:63,75 before any doc edit; the mechanism-claim-verifier gate's remediation (metadata.mechanism_verifications) records the citation and the correction on the SD record itself.

risks.risk: docs/guides/workflow/cli-venture-lifecycle/reference/gate-thresholds.md's broader DEFAULTS illustration block mixes in several keys (gross_margin_min, breakeven_months_max, etc.) that do not belong to decision-filter-engine.js at all -- a pre-existing, separate staleness this SD does not fix
risks.mitigation: Out of scope, named explicitly here and in the completion attestation so it is not mistaken for 'already checked'.

risks.risk: Other EVA-adjacent docs (05-chairman-preferences.md, reference/chairman-decisions.md, reference/kill-gates.md, and ~8 more) were matched during the Explore pass but contain no min_score/chairman_review_score threshold documentation at all -- a reader could assume they were also checked-and-clean for THIS specific key when they simply never mentioned it
risks.mitigation: Confirmed via Explore sub-agent evidence (stored, LEAD-TO-PLAN gate) that these files were searched and found to not reference the threshold values in question; no edit was needed or made to them.
